title: Eye of Dalaran
wikitext:
Source of [[magic]] for the [[nation]] of [[Dalaran]] which guards their borders and allows a secure environment for the magocratic nation. The Eye was spirited away when the [[Horde]] invaded Dalaran, but brought back when they rebuilt the city. [[Ner'Zhul]] tried to steal the Eye, but was repulsed (we assume the Eye could have stabilized [[Draenor]] when the [[Dimensional Gateway]]s opened). The Eye was kept in Dalaran, but its powers were not enough to stop [[Archimonde]] from destroying the city. 

We know is wasn't in the city ruins, because [[Illidan Stormrage]] or [[Kael'thas Sunstrider]] would surely have tried to obtain it. Some have speculated that [[Jaina]] or [[Medivh]] took it to [[Kalimdor]], meaning that it resides either in [[Stonetalon Peak]] or [[Theramore Isle|Theramore]] [the latter being more likely], if the artifact even exists anymore. We think the Eye could be used in methods similar to both the [[Sunwell]] and the [[Eye of Sargeras]].
